function: VGG and LSTM feature-fusion networks perform Wi-Fi activity recognition and localization
note: The learned networks perform Wi-Fi activity recognition, localization, and distance estimation, which is sensing alone and none of the seven functions, with ISAC only as motivation.

function: Radar processing of communication echoes provides priors for delay-Doppler channel estimation
note: The echo-aided channel estimator uses radar signal processing and delay-Doppler sparsity with no learned component, and deep learning appears only as a baseline.

function: Deep reinforcement learning makes task scheduling decisions in hybrid GEO-LEO marine IoT
note: Deep reinforcement learning decides task scheduling and gateway association for orbital processing, which is above the physical layer, while resource allocation uses Lagrange multipliers without learning.

function: DNN predicts user-satellite association; beamforming and RIS phases solved by SCA
note: The DNN learns only the user-satellite association, which is above the physical layer, while beamforming and RIS phase shifts are obtained by successive convex approximation without learning.

function: Convex optimization of batch size, dropout rate, and powers for federated learning
note: Batch size, dropout rate, and sensing and communication power are optimized by sorting and successive convex approximation without learning, and the federated edge learning served by the link aggregates models digitally rather than over the air.

function: Dueling double DQN makes relay decisions minimizing age of information in V2V
note: The DRL agent learns relay transmission decisions under energy and data buffer limits to minimize age of information, a scheduling decision above the physical layer, and the abstract does not say that it configures the RIS.

function: Dueling DQN jointly decides LEO access selection, computation offloading, and computing resources
note: Learning decides access selection, computation offloading, and computation resource allocation in LEO edge computing, all above the physical layer.

function: Grey wolf metaheuristic fuses RSS and AoA for IRS-aided visible light positioning
note: The grey wolf optimizer with dimension learning-based hunting is a metaheuristic search rather than a model trained on data, and the task is indoor positioning.

function: Transfer learning detects faulty RIS elements; CNN-VAE and DenseNet localize users
note: The learned models detect faulty RIS elements and reconstruct RIS signals only to estimate the user location, and localization is outside the seven functions.

function: Multi-objective deep Q-network learns beam handover in multi-beam LEO satellite networks
note: Handover is listed as above the physical layer, but the learned policy switches users among satellite beams to maximize throughput, which borders on learned beam control in satellite links, so the full text should decide.

function: Deep learning derives semantic keys combined with RF fingerprints for digital signatures
note: Deep learning generates security keys for digital signatures in semantic communication, which is authentication and key generation rather than one of the seven functions.

function: Neural network jointly estimates user location and synchronization under hardware impairments
note: The neural network performs joint localization and synchronization in a RIS-assisted mmWave system, and both functions are outside the seven areas.

function: Presents a cross-layer vision of integrated sensing and communication for 6G
note: This Hexa-X-II paper presents a cross-layer vision and perspective on ISAC that summarizes principles and enabling technologies rather than proposing and evaluating a method.

function: Siamese network with fuzzy logic decides user-receiver association in TN-NTN uplink
note: The Siamese network with fuzzy logic decides which satellite, UAV, or base station each user associates with, taking transmit power and subchannel allocation as inputs, so learning is applied to user association above the physical layer.

function: Closed-form semi-blind subspace channel estimation for wideband RIS-assisted mmWave
note: The channel estimator combines a covariance subspace constraint with a least-squares pilot term and has a closed-form solution, with no learned component.

function: Graph neural network actor selects task execution paths in LEO edge computing
note: The graph neural network learns task assignment and scheduling for satellite-terrestrial edge computing, which is above the physical layer, while bandwidth and processor sharing use closed-form KKT allocation.

function: Clustered multi-agent DDPG schedules UAV task offloading in space-air-ground networks
note: Multi-agent reinforcement learning makes task offloading and scheduling decisions among UAV clusters, which is above the physical layer.

function: PPO jointly chooses model split layers, client-UAV pairing, and UAV computing resources
note: Learning decides model splitting, client-UAV pairing, and UAV computing resources for split federated learning, all above the physical layer and without over-the-air aggregation.

function: ResNet1D and Transformer models classify rainfall from sub-6 GHz CSI
note: The learned models classify rainfall from channel state information, which is environmental sensing alone with no learned communication function despite the ISAC motivation.

function: Optimizes quantization bits, AirComp transceivers, and hybrid RIS for edge inference
note: The AirComp transceivers, receive beamforming, and hybrid RIS reflection are optimized by an algorithm without learning to aggregate features for edge inference, and no model is trained across the devices over the air.

function: Multi-agent DRL optimizes UAV trajectories in IRS-assisted UAV computing power networks
note: Learning is used only for the UAV trajectory, which is above the physical layer, while IRS phase shifts follow phase alignment and the other variables use matching and successive convex approximation.

function: Multi-agent reinforcement learning schedules tasks and computing power across cislunar nodes
note: Multi-agent reinforcement learning schedules tasks and coordinates computing power across lunar devices and satellites, which is above the physical layer.

function: Gradient-based MCMC sampler in discrete spaces performs Bayesian MIMO detection
note: The detector is a gradient-based Markov chain Monte Carlo sampler with proven convergence and no training on data, so it is an iterative algorithm although the authors call these techniques machine learning.

function: DRL controls UAV formation path-following and online obstacle avoidance
note: Learning controls UAV formation path-following and obstacle avoidance, which concern the UAV trajectory above the physical layer, while the ISAC obstacle estimation is not learned.

function: Reinforcement learning plans the eavesdropping UAV trajectory; precoder and combiner via SDR
note: Only the UAV trajectory is learned, which is above the physical layer, while the relay precoder and the receive combiner are optimized by semidefinite relaxation and a low-complexity solution.

function: Dueling double DQN plans UAV trajectory for ISAC sensing of IoT nodes
note: The learned decision is only the UAV trajectory, which is listed as above the physical layer, and no beam, waveform, power, or radio resource is learned.

function: Randomizes commercial Wi-Fi beamforming vectors to thwart adversarial Wi-Fi sensing
note: BeamDancer randomizes beamforming vectors without a learned component, and learning appears only in the adversarial sensing techniques used for evaluation.

function: ConvNeXt refines angle and distance estimates for near-field XL-MIMO user localization
note: The learned model estimates user angle and distance for near-field localization, and localization is outside the seven functions.

function: Unsupervised model-driven autoencoder estimates angles of arrival in massive MIMO
note: The autoencoder performs angle-of-arrival estimation alone, and the abstract states no channel estimation, detection, or beamforming built on it.
